title: Traceable Failure Chains and Decision Logic
rule_a_plus_statement: No random death. Death comes only from an environmental limit breach driven by an identifiable player choice or failure to act.

chains.name: Lunar Night Power Blackout & Hypercapnia
chains.name_zh: 月夜断电引发二氧化碳窒息连锁
sequence_steps: Solar array output drops to 0.0 kW as sun sets below the horizon
Outpost continues running full factory loads without shedding non-essential power
Battery reserves deplete completely to 0 kWh at Night Hour 110
Unpowered CDRA scrubber ceases chemical amine absorption
Crew respiration accumulates metabolic CO2 past the critical ceiling of 7.5 mmHg (1.0 kPa)
chains.cause_of_death_scientific: Acute hypercapnia, severe respiratory acidosis, and cognitive collapse
chains.traceability_sentence_template: On Day {day} at {hour}:00, I chose {decision_text}, which pushed Cabin CO2 to {value} mmHg (limit 3.0 mmHg), so I did not survive.
chains.traceability_sentence_template_zh: 第 {day} 天 {hour}:00，我选择【{decision_text}】，导致舱内二氧化碳升至 {value} mmHg（安全上限 3.0 mmHg），所以我没能活下来。
chains.how_nasa_avoids_it: NASA Artemis Base Camp flight rules mandate automatic load-shedding to secondary life-support priorities and deploy passive LiOH backup scrubbers.
chains.citation: NASA NTRS 20150021777: SMAC for Carbon Dioxide & LSII Surface Power.

chains.name: Unpatched Micrometeoroid Breach & Decompression
chains.name_zh: 微陨石穿孔未及时修补引发减压连锁
sequence_steps: High-velocity micrometeoroid punctures habitat pressure vessel shell
Pressure begins leaking at 0.8 kPa per hour
Player chooses to postpone repair and rely on buffer gas rather than expending patch materials
Atmospheric buffer depleted; cabin pressure falls through 90 kPa (Caution) to 75 kPa (Warning)
Cabin total pressure plummets below critical 70.0 kPa (10.1 psia)
chains.cause_of_death_scientific: Acute hypoxic hypoxia and rapid decompression sickness (ebullism risk threshold)
chains.traceability_sentence_template: On Day {day} at {hour}:00, I chose {decision_text}, which pushed Cabin Pressure down to {value} kPa (nominal 101.3 kPa), so I did not survive.
chains.traceability_sentence_template_zh: 第 {day} 天 {hour}:00，我选择【{decision_text}】，导致舱内总压跌至 {value} kPa（标准标称 101.3 kPa），所以我没能活下来。
chains.how_nasa_avoids_it: ISS Emergency Depressurization procedures require immediate hatch isolation of the punctured module within minutes.
chains.citation: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev D, Section 6.1 (Pressure Integrity).

chains.name: Solar Particle Event Unshielded Exposure
chains.name_zh: 强行暴露于太阳粒子风暴引发急性辐射病
sequence_steps: Solar monitoring satellite warns of high-energy proton surge
Player decides to ignore warning and keep astronaut outside mining ice
Intense proton flux impacts unshielded astronaut at >150 mSv/hour
Total cumulative dose surpasses the 600 mSv NASA lifetime occupational cap
Radiation exceeds acute clinical toxicity threshold (>1000 mSv equivalent)
chains.cause_of_death_scientific: Acute radiation syndrome (hematopoietic and gastrointestinal collapse)
chains.traceability_sentence_template: On Day {day} at {hour}:00, I chose {decision_text}, which pushed Radiation Dose to {value} mSv (career cap 600 mSv), so I did not survive.
chains.traceability_sentence_template_zh: 第 {day} 天 {hour}:00，我选择【{decision_text}】，导致累积辐射剂量骤升至 {value} mSv（终身安全上限 600 mSv），所以我没能活下来。
chains.how_nasa_avoids_it: Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) mandates immediate crew recall to storm shelters shielded by regolith or water tanks.
chains.citation: NASA Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) Operational Limits.

chains.name: Spacewalk Consumable Overextension
chains.name_zh: 出舱作业严重超时导致宇航服缺氧
sequence_steps: Astronaut completes standard 7-hour sortie limit at distant crater rim
Player decides to dig for one more batch of ice rather than returning
Primary PLSS oxygen bottle exhausts at Hour 7.2
Secondary 30-minute emergency pack engages while still 45 minutes walking distance from airlock
Suit oxygen pressure drops to 0.0 kPa before ingress can occur
chains.cause_of_death_scientific: Anoxia and suffocation inside the extravehicular mobility suit
chains.traceability_sentence_template: On Day {day} at {hour}:00, I chose {decision_text}, which pushed Suit Oxygen down to {value} minutes, so I did not survive.
chains.traceability_sentence_template_zh: 第 {day} 天 {hour}:00，我选择【{decision_text}】，导致宇航服氧气耗尽至 {value} 分钟（违反 7 小时安全法则），所以我没能活下来。
chains.how_nasa_does_it: Strict EVA flight rules enforce 'Point of No Return' consumable thresholds based on return walk time and terrain difficulty.
chains.citation: NASA STEM Artemis Generation Spacesuits Activity (Consumables Rule).

chains.name: Greenhouse Neglect & Food Reserve Depletion
chains.name_zh: 温室断电弃管导致粮食断绝衰竭
chains.trigger_event: Logistical failure to cultivate and prioritize crop cycle
sequence_steps: Prepackaged astronaut rations dwindle to critical 5 days
Player routes water and electricity away from the Veggie greenhouse to run excess mining
Hydroponic lettuce and crop seedlings desiccate and die
Ration inventory hits 0 kcal with no fresh harvest available
Crew energy deficit triggers severe metabolic exhaustion and incapacitation
chains.cause_of_death_scientific: Metabolic exhaustion and multi-system organ failure from severe prolonged starvation
chains.traceability_sentence_template: On Day {day} at {hour}:00, I chose {decision_text}, which pushed Food Reserves to {value} days, so I did not survive.
chains.traceability_sentence_template_zh: 第 {day} 天 {hour}:00，我选择【{decision_text}】，导致粮食储备归零（{value} 天余量），所以我没能活下来。
chains.how_nasa_does_it: NASA deep-space missions require a minimum 30% consumable logistics margin on calories and macro-nutrients.
chains.citation: NASA Human Integration Design Handbook (HIDH), Consumables Margin Planning.
